request.prompt: Create a meticulous photographic reconstruction reference of ONLY THE SAME WOMAN in the supplied image. Preserve Astrid's exact identity and age: same proportions of eyes/nose/mouth/jaw, same direct relaxed blue-grey eyes, closed neutral lips, ears, skin tone, blonde hair swept into the same neat low bun and fine individual hairs, black tailored blazer and ivory blouse. This is a face fidelity reference for 3D reconstruction, NOT a stylized character design. Front-on eye-level camera, portrait lens without perspective distortion, head level and straight, shoulders level. Frame from complete top of hair down to upper chest, full shoulders visible, face and hair occupy most of the image. Remove casino, table and hands; uniform neutral medium-grey studio background. Soft broad neutral diffuse light reveals skin pores, subtle lip and eyelid structure, fabric weave and hair strands with minimal baked shadow. No glamour retouching, no smoothing, no CGI, no wax/plastic, no exaggerated makeup, no changes of identity, no sculpt base, no text, no grid, no collage. Single frontal head-and-shoulders photograph, natural anatomy and expression.
